title: TraceDeposit
description: A single trace deposited into a stigmergic medium by one agent. Append-only, never mutated. Carries consequence-edges for R5 loop-closure. Schema mirrors the deposit() return shape in emergence/stigmergy/index.js.

id.description: Content-addressed stable id for this deposit.

agentId.description: Opaque agent identifier. Agents cannot address each other through this (R1).

trace.description: Opaque payload — the trace content the agent deposited.

offGradient.description: True if this deposit was exploratory (off-gradient, R4 stochastic exploration).

turn.description: Monotonic turn number when this deposit was appended.
